show.description: After being betrayed by her own family, Sanya returns six years later with her twins, Ayan and Ahana, seeking justice—and her stolen third child. As she crosses paths with Ishaan, the man unknowingly connected to her past, secrets unravel, and her triplets become the center of a storm involving love, lies, and revenge. With Riya—the woman who tried to destroy her—still plotting, Sanya must fight to reclaim her children and her destiny. Watch Now!
